title: Smartlead Pricing: Plans, Add-Ons and Costs (2026)
summary: Smartlead pricing ranges from $32 to $379 monthly depending on the plan and billing cycle. Compare tiers to find which supports your outreach volume.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Can you cancel Smartlead anytime or get a refund?


Cancelling a subscription is a billing-settings action. Whether you get money back for the unused part of a paid period is set by Smartlead's terms, and I haven't confirmed those terms here. Treat any paid period as spent once it starts.


If you pay monthly, the most a bad month can cost is that month's plan plus add-ons; the billing cycle is the unit that matters. If you prepay for longer, a refund you assumed was available could be the whole exposure.


Read the refund wording on the terms page before entering a card, and note the date you read it, since billing policies change.


### What happens when you hit the monthly email limit?


The metered unit is emails sent per month, and the cap is a ceiling on that count.


What Smartlead does at the ceiling (pause sending, block new campaigns, or charge for the excess) is the detail to confirm on its pricing and help pages before you rely on it.


Either way, a cap hit mid-cycle means stalled sequences or an unplanned upgrade, so size the tier to your busiest month, not your average one. Follow-ups count as sends too, so a multi-step sequence uses the allowance faster than the lead count suggests.


### Can you change Smartlead plans mid-month?


You don't have to wait for the cycle to end to change plans; the change is made from the account's billing settings.


How the switch is charged (a prorated difference, a credit for unused time, or a new cycle starting immediately) is a billing-terms question I haven't verified.


The safe habit is to upgrade as close to the start of a cycle as you can, so you're not paying a higher rate for days you barely use.


If you're close to a limit, compare the cost of upgrading now against the cost of stalled sends until the reset.


### Are warmup and unlimited mailboxes really included?


Warmup and unlimited mailbox connections are features of the plan, but "unlimited" describes how many mailboxes you can connect to Smartlead, not what those mailboxes cost to create.


The mailbox seats from your email provider and the sending domains are separate purchases, and they scale with your volume.


Two things are worth checking on the pricing page. First, whether warmup emails count against your monthly email allowance. Second, whether any warmup feature is limited to certain tiers.


Then add provider seats and domain registration to the plan price, because that total is your real bill.
